sections.Description: Ballantine’s blended Scotch whisky is exported to over 160 countries and is one of the biggest Scotch brands in the world. Ballantine’s blends malt and grain whiskies from all four whisky regions of Scotland, Speyside, Islay, Highlands and Lowlands. The recipe of the Ballantine’s Finest is the most ancient of the distillery’s whisky recipes, and it was formulated as early as 1910 by the Ballantine family. It contains over 40 whisky malts and grains, carefully chosen from the four regions owned by the Scottish distillery, which is rated third in the world among the best-selling whisky brands. Ballantine’s Finest has remained true to the original recipe since 1910 and is also Ballantine’s very first recipe

Black & White Whisky is a classic blended whisky. His trademark is the two terriers, Black & White. It is one of the most popular and well-known Scotch Whiskies with a very long history. Because the brand Black & White Whisky was brought into being almost 200 years ago. This was done by the company Buchanan & Co Ltd, which James Buchanan founded. Therefore, the Black & White Scotch was initially marketed as “The Buchanan Blend” and later renamed “House of Commons”. Because his customers always ordered only the “Black & White” because of the black and white label, the whisky was also called “The Buchanan Blend” from then on. Also the idea for the famous terriers, a black Scottish Terrier and a white West Highland White Terrier, still came from the founder himself

With the establishment of the Bulleit distillery, Tom Bulleit has fulfilled a dream. He was inspired by his great-great-grandfather Augustus Bulleit. The subtlety and complexity of Bulleit Bourbon come from its unique blend of rye, corn, and barley malt, along with special strains of yeast and pure Kentucky limestone filtered water. Due to its especially high rye content, Bulleit Bourbon has a bold, spicy character with a finish that’s distinctively clean and smooth. Medium amber in colour, with gentle spiciness and sweet oak aromas. Mid-palate is smooth with tones of maple, oak, and nutmeg. The finish is long, dry, and satiny with a light toffee flavour. Bulleit Bourbon has been awarded the Mixology Bar Award 2014 – Spirit of the Year!

Hibiki’ is the model of harmony and means as much as resonance in Japanese.The Hibiki bottlings are subtleties of nature that reflect the traditional Japanese calendar. This Hibiki is a fine mixture of different malts and grain whiskies. The marriage creates a balanced harmony

Auchentoshan 12 Years is a remarkably good whisky from the Lowlands. Unlike other single malt whiskies, the Auchentoshan 12 Years has been distilled three times as compared to other single malts being distilled twice. Auchentoshan 12 Years is particularly smooth and pure in taste and matures in North American Bourbon oak casks. This whisky won the Silver Medal in 2018 at the International Spirits Challenge

The name Auchentoshan “Three Wood” mirrors the number of times the whisky has been distilled. The name Three Wood is due to the maturation in 3 different wooden barrels. This whisky matures for about 10 years in ex-Bourbon casks, then in Oloroso Sherry casks for an estimated 2 years before it is finally put into a PX-Sherry cask for another 6 months to add a good punch of sweetness. The Auchentoshan Three Wood whiskey won the Silver Mental in 2018 at the International Spirits Challenge and Chairman’s Trophy in 2012 at the Ultimate Cocktail challenge for the best Scotch Whisky
The Yeomen Warders are the ceremonial guardians of the Tower of London. They are affectionately known as the Beefeaters. The recipe dates back to 1863 and is a prime example of London Dry Gin

Absolut Vodka is the third largest brand of spirits in the world. Absolut Vodka is made from Southern Swedish winter wheat and pure spring water. The spring water is scooped from a deep well in Åhus, where it is protected from dirt and contamination

Belvedere means ‘beautiful to look at’ and is the name of the historic royal palace in Poland. This vodka is made from 100% rye and is distilled four times with the experience of over 500 years of tradition. Belvedere Vodka has won 3 gold medals at the Vodka Masters 2013 in London in the categories of Super Premium, Eastern Europe, and Smooth. In 2013 Belvedere Vodka was honoured 20 more times with medals and other awards, making it one of the most awarded vodkas in history

Clase Azul Tequila – a bottle of true art. All bottles of the Clase Azul distillery are shaped by hand and individually painted – no bottle resembles the other. The Clase Azul Tequila Reposado is an Ultra Premium Tequila, which is made from the Blue Weberagave. It is aged for 8 months in American whisky barrels, which gives the tequila its unique flavours.
Produced in small batches and aged for a minimum of Two and a half years, Don Julio 1942 Tequila is handcrafted in tribute to the year that Don Julio González began his tequila making journey

Hennessy VSOP is a cognac that is at least 4 years old, aged in Limousin oak barrels. Strong bouquet of fruits, some hints of honey and more fruits on the nose. The palate and the finish is dominated by woody hints of the cask. One of the world’s best Cognacs

Martell VSOP is a blend of eaux-de-vie, the youngest of which has aged for at least 4 years. This cognac offers a perfect balance between the lusciously fine, fruity notes and the subtle woody overtones. Elegant and harmonious
Jinro Original Soju (Jinro Fresh Soju) also known as Korean vodka, is prized for its smooth and clean taste that is perfected through natural methods of bamboo charcoal filtration
Jinro Original Soju (Jinro Fresh Soju) also known as Korean vodka, is prized for its smooth and clean taste that is perfected through natural methods of bamboo charcoal filtration
Baileys Original Irish Cream is the sweetest meeting of fine Irish whisky and spirits. Drink neat over ice, shake into cocktails or drizzle over ice-cream
Classic Coca-Cola flavour — a fizzy, refreshing carbonated cola drink with a sweet taste enjoyed worldwide. Perfect chilled anytime

The name Chivas Regal is derived from Schivas Castle on the River Ythan in the Scottish province of Aberdeenshire. Chivas Regal Scotch 12 Years Old blends many malts and grain Scotch whiskies. A maturation of at least 12 years is required to bottle this blend with style, substance, and tradition. Chivas 12 is smooth, rich and generous. It’s a blend of the finest malt and grain whiskies matured for at least 12 years, that delivers luxurious honey, vanilla and ripe apple notes. This 12-year-old blend embraces iconic Speyside flavours. Crisp orchard fruits, wild heather and sweet honey are the results of years of craft from Master Blenders

The name Chivas Regal is derived from Schivas Castle on the River Ythan in the Scottish province of Aberdeenshire. tradition. The Chivas Regal Scotch 18 Years Old Gold Signature is a unique and complex blend from one of the most experienced master blenders in the world; Colin Scott. His premium blend consists of various malt and grain whiskys from distilleries all over Scotland. The classic Speyside malt “Strathisla” is just one example of many specialities. The age indication of 18 years stands for the age of the youngest whisky contained. Each Chivas Regal whisky undergoes a triple glare so that Chivas Regal whisky is called the mildest Scotch whisky

The Royal Salute Collection of Chivas Brothers includes an exceptional selection of Scotch Whisky, starting with the age of 21 years. This collection starts where others stop. – Royal Salute is dedicated to those who seek and enjoy the highest form of luxury. The Chivas Regal Royal Salute 21 Years is a blend of history, launched in 1952. The name “Royal Salute” is derived from the 21 salutes fired at the coronation of Queen Elizabeth II

Founded by John Dewar in 1846. Single malt and grain whiskies are blended together, placed back into oak casks, and get to know each other. Dewar’s White Label remains a hugely popular blend, especially Stateside. It contains around 40 of Scotland’s finest single malts, with Aberfeldy at its heart

One of the world’s most popular blends, and the best-selling Scotch whisky in Scotland. Famous Grouse is a very nicely balanced, malty blend which was first made in 1800. The blend represents great value for money, and it also works beautifully in whisky-based cocktails. A perennial favourite with critics and connoisseurs alike, The Famous Grouse is a superb blend with a great deal of character

Jameson is a mature Pot Still whisky and one of the most famous Irish Blends. It is made from a mixture of malted and unmalted barley and goes through 3 distillation processes. It is then aged in oak barrels from Spain, Portugal and the USA, in which sherry, port or bourbon have matured. The whisky is then blended by the Master Blender from whiskys of different ages and casks

Johnnie Walker Black Label is a true icon that sets the standard for all other luxury blended whiskies. The distinctive smooth, deep and complex character of Johnnie Walker is created by blending whiskies matured for at least 12 years from all four corners of Scotland

Johnnie Walker Blue Label is an incomparable masterpiece. It is an exquisite combination of some of the rarest and most exceptional whiskies in Scotland. Only one in ten thousand casks have this unique quality, character and aroma with which the typical special taste of Johnnie Walker Blue Label can be achieved. An exceptional whisky for exceptional occasions
An 18-year-old Cardhu single malt forms the heart of the Gold Label, which with its oak aroma and mild, malty taste gives this great whisky its note

Johnnie Walker Red Label is a blended whisky that has been produced by Johnnie Walker since 1909. A versatile and pleasing whisky with a strong character, which also develops its taste in mixed drinks

John Walker & Sons XR 21 was created to honour this very special occasion. Inspired by Sir Alexander’s own hand-written notes, it is blended from the exclusive Johnnie Walker reserve of rare whiskies, all of which have been matured for a full 21 years

The first Triple Malt Scotch Whisky worldwide! The name is to be understood as a reminiscence of the traditions: In the old days, distillery workers used to shovel the germinating barley by the ton, hour after hour by hand. From this hard work, their shoulders sometimes hurt and their arms hung down low, almost like a chimpanzee. These temporary ailments were called ‘monkey shoulders’ and this Scotch was named after them. Monkey Shoulder is a blend of whisky from Balvenie, Glenfiddich and Kininvie, hence the name ‘Triple Malt’. Unlike traditional blends, Monkey Shoulder is 100% malt whisky
Teacher’s is a powerful Scotch whisky from the Scottish Highlands. The unusually high proportion of malt characterises its rich and full-malty taste, which is why it is also called ‘Highland Cream’

Teeling Irish Whisky Rum Finish stands out for its very high malt content. The Grain and Malt Whiskies are matured separately in ex-Bourbon casks in a 3:1 ratio of grain to malt. The whiskeys are milled in small quantities and then receive a finish in American rum casks

The motto of Jack Daniel was “Every day we make it, we’ll make it the best we can”. For him, this meant filtering his whisky drop by drop through a three-meter thick layer of charcoal from the sugar maple. Seven generations later, whisky is still filtered in the same way Jack used to filter it. The reason for this: Filtering gives it the unmistakable mildness that you’d expect from Jack Daniel’s. The Charcoal Mellowing makes Jack Daniel’s what it is: not bourbon, but a Tennessee whisky. This process refines the full taste of the whisky, even more so when it is fully matured in casks of Jack Daniel’s own production. This is a laborious process that requires special attention and makes the whisky a little more expensive to make. However, another process would not have met with Jack’s approval

Jim Beam Original is a classic Kentucky bourbon. It contains no additives or colouring and is as significant to sip on its own as it is to mix into cocktails. Jim Beam White is aged 4 years in traditional oak barrels and produced without artificial additions or food colouring. This is a light whisky with a sweet and delicate aroma and fragrances

The Nikka was first introduced in 2014, as a limited edition as “The Nikka 40 Years Old” to celebrate Nikka’s 80th anniversary. The asymmetric bottle design represents layers of tradition and heritage inherited from the Foundation, and the Nikka emblem is a symbol of its craftsmanship. The Nikka Tailored is a premium blend of whiskies from the distillery Miyagikyo (Honshu) and Yoichi (Hokkaido) distilled in Coffey Still

The award-winning Nikka from the Barrel blend is absolutely full of flavour. The blend combines both single malt and grain whisky from the Miyagikyo and Yoichi distilleries, which are then married in a huge variety of casks, including bourbon barrels, sherry butts and refill hogsheads. A huge depth of flavour in this stunning Japanese whisky
Suntory Whisky Kakubin is in Japan since 1937. It is a blended japanese whisky that is aged in former bourbon barrels of Yamazaki and Hakushu Distillery

Made from strongly peaty barley, the Yamazaki 12-Year-Old stands out above all for its oriental sandalwood note. It gives it a character that cannot be compared to any European single malt or Scotch. the Yamazaki 12-Year-Old matures for at least 12 years in American, Spanish and Japanese oak barrels
Yamazaki Distiller’s Reserve is a young Yamazaki Single Malt, which is aged in ex-red wine barrels for three years

Since the foundation of the Balvenie distillery, there have been hardly any changes; the Single Malts are still produced in the traditional way. The Balvenie, with its sister distillery Glenfiddich, is still independent and family-owned by its founders. The 12-year-old Balvenie Double Wood first matures in Bourbon barrels (10 years unverified). For perfection, it is then matured in Spanish Sherry First-Fill barrels
The Dalmore 12 Years was matured in bourbon and oloroso sherry casks. A very complex single malt with wonderfully combined flavors and excellent value for money

A favorite expression in the Dalmore stable, the Dalmore 15 Years is elegant and smooth, with lip-smacking texture and the flawless balance one would expect from blending maestro Richard Paterson. Matured in matusalem, apostoles and amoroso sherry casks, it proffers all those winter spice, orange zest and chocolate notes characteristic of Dalmore

Glenfiddich is a whisky distillery near Dufftown in the former County Banffshire in Scotland and is the largest single malt producer in Scotland. The Glenfiddich 12 Years Old is a classic among the single malt whiskies, which matures for 12 years in oak casks and has a distinctive harmonious taste. The pioneer of the single malt category is matured in the best oloroso sherry and bourbon casks. Uniquely united in oak casks, it develops superbly balanced fresh and complex notes. A Scotch whisky that is particularly well suited for beginners.

The Glenfiddich 15 has matured for 15 years in three kinds of wood: Sherry, Bourbon and New Oak. The Soleramethode, known from the traditional sherry production is used to achieve a constant quality. The so-called Solera Vat always remains half-filled

A truly exceptional single malt, the result not just of eighteen years of care and attention, but of whisky-making craft and knowledge passed down through the generations. Each note of maturing whisky grows and develops over time inside the casks. The baked apple notes of the whisky were once notes of fresh pear, now mellowed and softened. Spanish Oloroso wood and American oak are used to mature this rich, intriguingly fruity and robust oak expression, but there are many more reasons why this expression is special. Each has extraordinary consistency and character from an intense marrying period, and a warming, distinguished finish.

Glenlivet 12 undergoes aging in a variety of American and European barrels, which provides it with fragrances of vanilla and a smooth and unique flavor. This exceptional “Double Oak” maturation allows the finest aromas and flavours to develop over the years. The water used for the preparation of this whiskey is drawn from a single well to ensure the highest quality, which will be expressed in the whisky’s unique flavors.

Kavalan Oloroso Sherry Oak dilutes the Solist Oloroso Sherry with Kavalan spring water to 46% alcoholic strength. It is easy to drink and is the perfect single malt whisky to share with friends and family. Clean and complex with multiple layers of dried fruit, nuttiness and spices, it has some marzipan and vanilla touches to it
The Macallan 12 Years Double Cask matures for 12 years in a perfectly balanced combination of American sherry barrels and European oak barrels

Macallan 12 Years Sherry Oak matures for 12 years in sherry barrels. It features a series of single malt whiskies matured exclusively in hand-picked sherry seasoned oak casks from Jerez for richness and complexity

The Singleton of Dufftown 12 Years Old matures for 12 years in American oak bourbon barrels and later in European oak sherry barrels. Dufftown is the name of a town in the Speyside region of the Scottish Highlands. The town itself is home to many distilleries, including Balvenie, Glenfiddich, Mortlach, and others. This means that the name of this particular bottle could be translated as “a single malt made in a town where a lot of other single malts are also made”. This 12-year is aged in a combination of ex-bourbon and “European oak” casks, which could mean a lot of different things
The Singleton of Dufftown 15 Years Old matures in European and American oak barrels. The flat bottle design stands out from the usual standard bottle and is convincing

Our 18 year old single malt scotch whisky is matured in a high proportion of American oak casks with a small portion of European oak casks to balance the liquid. The result is smooth, sublime and full of character notes of sweet, stewed fruits, sumptuous berries, dark toffee and silky honey
Santa Helena Sauvignon Blanc is a fresh and crisp wine with citrus and green apple aromas. The palate is clean, with lime and passionfruit flavors, finishing dry and refreshing
Santa Helena Chardonnay is a full-bodied wine with a round texture and flavors of peach, melon, and subtle oak. It finishes smoothly with a touch of oak

A refreshing Australian Sauvignon Blanc from the McGuigan Black Label range — vibrant, crisp, and fruit-driven. It’s bursting with passionfruit, peach, and zesty lime flavours, delivering a clean and invigorating profile

A classic Australian Chardonnay with tropical fruit and melon characteristics complemented by well-integrated vanillin oak influence. The wine offers a soft, smooth and creamy palate with ripe fruit flavours and subtle oak warmth, resulting in a lingering clean finish
Konrad Hole in the Water Sauvignon Blanc is a refreshing and crisp wine with tropical fruit aromas, including passionfruit and gooseberry, complemented by citrus flavors and a clean finish
Odfjell Armador Sauvignon Blanc is a refreshing, crisp wine with vibrant citrus and green apple notes. It finishes long and refreshing with herbal undertones

19 Crimes Hard Sauvignon Blanc offers a refined expression of freshness and structure. Its bright citrus and tropical fruit flavors are harmoniously balanced by crisp acidity, creating a clean, elegant palate that lingers with subtle minerality. A sophisticated white wine that embodies both character and finesse.

19 Crimes Hard Chard offers a bold and creamy flavor profile with notes of tropical fruit and light oak. Its smooth texture is complemented by a subtle spice finish, making it an enjoyable and accessible white wine

Santa Helena Merlot is a soft and versatile Chilean wine with a ruby-red color and aromas of red plums, raspberries, and a hint of cocoa. The palate is smooth, with flavors of ripe red fruits, light chocolate, and a touch of spice. Perfect for casual gatherings, it pairs well with roasted vegetables, pasta, or mild cheeses

Santa Helena Cabernet Sauvignon is a Chilean red wine from the Central Valley that’s known for being medium-to-full-bodied with rich, dark ruby colour and pronounced fruit character. It typically shows flavors and aromas of blackcurrant, plum, cherry, and other dark fruits balanced with subtle hints of spice, oak, vanilla and chocolate, supported by soft tannins and a smooth, rounded finish that makes it approachable yet flavorful
This Pinot Noir offers a smooth texture with red berry flavors and earthy notes, leading to an elegant and balanced finish
This Cabernet Sauvignon showcases dark red hues with aromas of licorice, dark fruits, and vanilla. The palate is filled with dark berry fruit, and the soft tannins provide a lingering finish

McGuigan Black Label Shiraz is a quintessential Australian Shiraz, offering a deep ruby-red color with aromas of ripe blackberries, plums, and hints of vanilla and spice. On the palate, this full-bodied wine delivers rich dark fruits, subtle oak spice, and smooth tannins, creating a perfectly balanced flavor. The velvety texture and warm finish make it an excellent choice for pairing with grilled meats, hearty dishes, or simply enjoying on its own

McGuigan Black Label Merlot is a smooth, easy-to-drink Merlot from Australia with flavors of red berries, plum, and chocolate. It has soft tannins and a subtle oak influence, making it approachable for casual drinking. This wine is perfect for pairing with pasta, pizza, or roasted meats

Konrad Hole in the Water Pinot Noir from New Zealand offers bright and fresh flavors typical of the Marlborough region. With aromas of ripe red fruits (raspberries, strawberries), it has a smooth mouthfeel with soft tannins and vibrant acidity. It’s elegant with a balanced finish and pairs well with grilled salmon, roasted poultry, or light pasta dishes

A Chilean Cabernet Sauvignon from Odfjell’s Armador line, crafted organically with biodynamic practices. It delivers fresh red fruit flavours, savory spice notes and balanced structure, ideal with red meats or hearty dishes.

Mother of Pearl Vodka is a premium Australian vodka brand inspired by the pristine coastal waters and the natural beauty of Australia’s shoreline. This grape base, along with a unique multi-stage distillation and filtration process, creates a smooth, neutral spirit with a silky, creamy, pearl-like finish and less “heat” on the palate, making it ideal neat, on ice, or as a cocktail base. The brand emphasizes quality, craft, and a lifestyle inspired by the sea.
